rationale: The broad online group actors improved both growth point estimates but lost late survival in one arm. Dense stochastic paths underperform greedy deployment on average. Train against greedy alternatives at the same natural states, keeping exploration sparse and credit only at sampled actions.
training: Two independent v1.4-r1-based full actors; four updates, each 128 natural v14 roots in each arm. Per root: same greedy prefix to T7/8/9, one current-policy greedy control, three independent paths whose non-forced choices independently use temperature 0.75 sampling with probability 0.25 and greedy actions otherwise through T12. Parent outside the active window. All four play to terminal rank; 4096 total games, no survivor filtering. Each actual sampled action receives original terminal utility minus half greedy utility minus half other two paths' mean utility. No target rewards, scripted cards or teacher instructions. Group-policy AdamW/clipping/reference KL and optimizer restoration unchanged. Reruns after engineering errors use new output directories.
validation: 256 new fixed v14hold game seeds 91100000 through 91100255, greedy parent and both fixed endpoints. D-128 common-survivor growth plus independent survival, original utility and rank criteria. Fresh 512-seed confirmation needed after passing. Frozen development study, no formal long training.
